run_waymo_data_curation: run the script to curate Waymo dataset camera images with LiDAR depth into JSONL
run_undistort_image: run the undistort_image function to remove lens distortion from a camera image using intrinsics
run_read_parquet: run the read function to load a Waymo dataset component parquet file as a Dask DataFrame
review_undistort_image: review the undistort_image function that applies OpenCV undistortion and transforms pixel coordinates
refactor_waymo_curation: refactor the Waymo data curation script to support custom output formats or subset processing
